name: MAC Mobility | PW <-> PW | Sticky/Non-sticky
reference_table: PW->PW: no RT-2 change; suppression NO; local loop NO; update ARP; no new RT-2
infra_reason: PW-to-PW move uses TWO Spirent VPLS BGP peers (VE-ID 1 and VE-ID 3), both sharing nexthop 6.6.6.6 via ISIS (STC devices on same port share ISIS instance). Each PW gets a unique ingress label. DNOS LDP requires IGP routes for label distribution. SI-enabled EVPN instance required -- VPLS RTs only valid under SI > protocols > bgp subtree.

prerequisites.expect: bgp-vpls row with non-zero label count
prerequisites.alt_check: show config routing-options | flatten | include bgp-vpls-label-block-size
prerequisites.known_bug: SW-253359: on cluster devices, label pool may show 0 even after config+restart

show config network-services evpn instance {pw_test_evpn_name} | no-more

prerequisites.critical_note: VPLS RTs ONLY valid under seamless-integration > protocols > bgp. Discovered 2026-04-11.

prerequisites.validation_note: VALIDATED PE-1 2026-04-11: BGP ESTABLISHED after full ISIS+LDP chain

prerequisites.note: Second Spirent VPLS peer (VE-ID 3) = PW2. Different IP, same VLAN. PE-1 sees two remote VPLS peers, two PWs.
